Stock market news | Nifty hits 9-month high as Rupee logs best weekly rally

On 20 November 2026 the Nifty index rose to a nine‑month high while the rupee posted its strongest weekly gain in five weeks. Bond yields also eased during the session.
Foreign investors have poured more than ₹1 lakh crore into Indian equities in November, helping the market shrug off worries about global technology stocks and high US yields.
